scoring_justification: Cell-CPA self-consistent simulation cannot be re-run in the lightweight verifier; comparing the agent's reported coverage series to the paper's published results with tolerances faithfully assesses reproduction quality.

outputs.description: Coverage-dependent work function change, charge transfer, and LDOS at the Fermi level for Cs/Si(001)2×1 at six coverages.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for the six-coverages arrays (work function change, charge transfer, LDOS) for Cs/Si(001)2×1 from the cell-CPA paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Surface Science 209 (1989) 131-150, figures and text; the reference solve.sh encodes the same values.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Digitized from the paper's reported coverage-dependent curves and discussion; tolerances allow for implementation spread.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values match the original paper's main result and are consistent with the reference oracle submission.
